Verify. Reach Bybit from its DefiLlama page or its official accounts, and match the contract addresses against its docs. Never sign an approval from a link sent in a direct message Cost: $0.00. Time: 5 minutes.
Fund. Move $10,000 of USDC straight to Solana from an exchange that supports it, or move it from Ethereum with a large bridge that lists Solana Cost: $1.00. Time: 10 minutes.
Risk. Read the strategy page and check what Bybit holds beneath it, so you know whose failure would take your deposit with it. The deposit is the capital at risk Cost: $0.00. Time: 10 minutes.

Core. Deposit $10,000 of USDC (or the asset the strategy names) into Bybit's main vault on Solana. Note the receipt token and check the deposit is counted before you leave Cost: $0.10. Time: 15 minutes.

Deepen. Hold the receipt token, or post it where Bybit lists a points boost (a lending market or an LP), but never loop it more than once. A second deployment on another chain lets the same wallet show activity on two chains Cost: $0.10. Time: 10 minutes.

Cadence. Touch the position once a week (a top-up, a claim, a vote) so the wallet shows steady use rather than one deposit. The team runs 12 weekly snapshots while you hold Cost: $1.20. Time: 60 minutes.

Watch. Exit rule, checked weekly: withdraw if Bybit's TVL prints below $11,750,789,772, which is 15% below today's $13,824,458,555; also if withdrawals are paused or the team stops publishing a snapshot Cost: $0.00. Time: 60 minutes.

Record. Keep a ledger from the first transaction: date, transaction hash, asset and dollar value of every top-up, claim and withdrawal. A claim may ask the wallet to prove its history, and a drop is taxable income in many places at its value on the day it arrives Cost: $0.00. Time: 5 minutes.
Claim. Claim only from the link Bybit publishes on its own page. Never pay to claim, and never paste a seed phrase anywhere to receive a drop Cost: $0.00. Time: 10 minutes.

Verify. Reach Abstract from its DefiLlama page or its official accounts, and match the contract addresses against its docs. Never sign an approval from a link sent in a direct message Cost: $0.00. Time: 5 minutes.
Fund. Move $1,876.76 of USDC straight to Ethereum from an exchange that supports it, or move it from Ethereum with a large bridge that lists Ethereum Cost: $1.00. Time: 10 minutes.
Risk. Read the strategy page and check what Abstract holds beneath it, so you know whose failure would take your deposit with it. The deposit is the capital at risk Cost: $0.00. Time: 10 minutes.

Core. Deposit $1,876.76 of USDC (or the asset the strategy names) into Abstract's main vault on Ethereum. Note the receipt token and check the deposit is counted before you leave Cost: $8.00. Time: 15 minutes.

Deepen. Hold the receipt token, or post it where Abstract lists a points boost (a lending market or an LP), but never loop it more than once. A second deployment on another chain lets the same wallet show activity on two chains Cost: $8.00. Time: 10 minutes.

Cadence. Touch the position once a week (a top-up, a claim, a vote) so the wallet shows steady use rather than one deposit. The team runs 12 weekly snapshots while you hold Cost: $96.00. Time: 60 minutes.

Watch. Exit rule, checked weekly: withdraw if Abstract's TVL prints below $7,976,231, which is 15% below today's $9,383,801; also if withdrawals are paused or the team stops publishing a snapshot Cost: $0.00. Time: 60 minutes.

Record. Keep a ledger from the first transaction: date, transaction hash, asset and dollar value of every top-up, claim and withdrawal. A claim may ask the wallet to prove its history, and a drop is taxable income in many places at its value on the day it arrives Cost: $0.00. Time: 5 minutes.
Claim. Claim only from the link Abstract publishes on its own page. Never pay to claim, and never paste a seed phrase anywhere to receive a drop Cost: $0.00. Time: 10 minutes.

rows.name: Morph Bridge
farm_steps: Setup. Use a fresh wallet (a hardware-backed account is best) that holds only the funds you plan to farm with, and withdraw about $5 of gas to it from an exchange Cost: $1.00. Time: 10 minutes.

Verify. Reach Morph Bridge from its DefiLlama page or its official accounts, and match the contract addresses against its docs. Never sign an approval from a link sent in a direct message Cost: $0.00. Time: 5 minutes.
Fund. Move $2,454.751 of USDC straight to Ethereum from an exchange that supports it, or move it from Ethereum with a large bridge that lists Ethereum Cost: $1.00. Time: 10 minutes.
Risk. Read the strategy page and check what Morph Bridge holds beneath it, so you know whose failure would take your deposit with it. The deposit is the capital at risk Cost: $0.00. Time: 10 minutes.

Core. Deposit $2,454.751 of USDC (or the asset the strategy names) into Morph Bridge's main vault on Ethereum. Note the receipt token and check the deposit is counted before you leave Cost: $8.00. Time: 15 minutes.

Deepen. Hold the receipt token, or post it where Morph Bridge lists a points boost (a lending market or an LP), but never loop it more than once. A second deployment on another chain lets the same wallet show activity on two chains Cost: $8.00. Time: 10 minutes.

Cadence. Touch the position once a week (a top-up, a claim, a vote) so the wallet shows steady use rather than one deposit. The team runs 12 weekly snapshots while you hold Cost: $96.00. Time: 60 minutes.

Watch. Exit rule, checked weekly: withdraw if Morph Bridge's TVL prints below $10,432,693, which is 15% below today's $12,273,756; also if withdrawals are paused or the team stops publishing a snapshot Cost: $0.00. Time: 60 minutes.

Record. Keep a ledger from the first transaction: date, transaction hash, asset and dollar value of every top-up, claim and withdrawal. A claim may ask the wallet to prove its history, and a drop is taxable income in many places at its value on the day it arrives Cost: $0.00. Time: 5 minutes.
Claim. Claim only from the link Morph Bridge publishes on its own page. Never pay to claim, and never paste a seed phrase anywhere to receive a drop Cost: $0.00. Time: 10 minutes.

Fund. Move $50 of USDC to Arbitrum from an exchange that supports it, and confirm the balance before you touch the app Cost: $1.00. Time: 10 minutes.
Use. Take one small position in NEAR Intents on Arbitrum and hold it until it resolves, so the wallet shows real use rather than a single deposit Cost: $0.10. Time: 15 minutes.
Repeat. Do this weekly for 5 weeks: one small position a week on Arbitrum, so the activity is counted in more than one snapshot Cost: $0.50. Time: 50 minutes.
Hold. Hold the position for at least 30 days in total, and before you withdraw open NEAR Intents's own rewards page and claim only from the link it publishes Cost: $0.00. Time: 10 minutes.
Record. Write the wallet, the dates and every transaction for NEAR Intents in a farm log so you can repeat the position or unwind it cleanly Cost: $0.00. Time: 5 minutes.

rows.name: Adrastea Validator
farm_steps: Setup. Use a fresh wallet (a hardware-backed account is best) that holds only the funds you plan to farm with, and withdraw about $5 of gas to it from an exchange Cost: $1.00. Time: 10 minutes.

Verify. Reach Adrastea Validator from its DefiLlama page or its official accounts, and match the contract addresses against its docs. Never sign an approval from a link sent in a direct message Cost: $0.00. Time: 5 minutes.
Fund. Move $4,421.336 of USDC straight to Solana from an exchange that supports it, or move it from Ethereum with a large bridge that lists Solana Cost: $1.00. Time: 10 minutes.

Risk. Read the strategy page and check what Adrastea Validator holds beneath it, so you know whose failure would take your deposit with it. The deposit is the capital at risk Cost: $0.00. Time: 10 minutes.

Core. Deposit $4,421.336 of USDC (or the asset the strategy names) into Adrastea Validator's main vault on Solana. Note the receipt token and check the deposit is counted before you leave Cost: $0.10. Time: 15 minutes.

Deepen. Hold the receipt token, or post it where Adrastea Validator lists a points boost (a lending market or an LP), but never loop it more than once. A second deployment on another chain lets the same wallet show activity on two chains Cost: $0.10. Time: 10 minutes.

Cadence. Touch the position once a week (a top-up, a claim, a vote) so the wallet shows steady use rather than one deposit. The team runs 12 weekly snapshots while you hold Cost: $1.20. Time: 60 minutes.

Watch. Exit rule, checked weekly: withdraw if Adrastea Validator's TVL prints below $18,790,680, which is 15% below today's $22,106,682; also if withdrawals are paused or the team stops publishing a snapshot Cost: $0.00. Time: 60 minutes.

Record. Keep a ledger from the first transaction: date, transaction hash, asset and dollar value of every top-up, claim and withdrawal. A claim may ask the wallet to prove its history, and a drop is taxable income in many places at its value on the day it arrives Cost: $0.00. Time: 5 minutes.
Claim. Claim only from the link Adrastea Validator publishes on its own page. Never pay to claim, and never paste a seed phrase anywhere to receive a drop Cost: $0.00. Time: 10 minutes.
